description: This PHP source file defines the EntityConfigBase class, a base class for importing configuration entities within Drupal's migrate module. It manages entity creation, updates, translation handling, and rollback functionality for configuration entities during migration.

classes.name: EntityConfigBase
classes.description: A base class for migrating configuration entities, handling creation, updates, translations, and rollback operations within Drupal migrations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityConfigBase with dependencies such as language manager and config factory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports a migration row into the configuration entity, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: isTranslationDestination
methods.description: Checks if the destination is for translation purposes based on configuration.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the ID keys for the entity, including 'langcode' if applicable.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an entity with data from a migration row, handling translations if necessary.

methods.name: updateEntityProperty
methods.description: Recursively updates nested entity properties with a given value.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the entity based on row data.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Reverts a migration by deleting or rolling back the configuration entity or its translation.
